title: Fridgeroo on Tour – Part 3: The party flat
feature: receipt scan (photo of the receipt → every item lands in the app)

scenes.label: 🚨 9-METRE RECEIPT
scenes.sfx: paper whirr 0.0, cups knocked 0.6/1.2, pizza box flop 1.5; bun girl stumbles after the roll (shock)
scenes.note: frame 1: receipt already half across the floor from her hand, past cups + pizza boxes, '40× LIME' line readable; party lights in clay look

scenes.say: Your receipt|needs a map.|YOU lost yours|too. Admit it.
scenes.note: hero hops on the receipt and SKATEBOARDS along it (skateboard prop under him), stops in front of her; stare on 'YOU'
scan beam runs down the receipt, it reels up into her phone; mini limes/pizza hop into the hologram rows

caption: Part 3 of Fridgeroo on Tour: after the party, one receipt covered the whole floor, so Fridgeroo skated it, scanned it and landed 42 items in the app 🛹 Use it or lose it. fridgeroo.netlify.app – Who in your group buys forty limes?

newProps.receipt: flat white strip (~9 m, slight curl, printed rows incl. '40× LIME' sprite) unrolling from her hand across the floor along a gentle S-curve, past cups/pizza boxes (no wrapping around objects). Action receipt {rollAt, reelAt}: unroll with paper whirr; at reelAt a mint scan highlight sweeps along it and it reels back into her phone (shrinking from the far end).
newProps.skateboard: small board under the hero during scene 2 (hero glides along the receipt with 2 hops, lands, board flips up into his hand).
newProps.lime: small green sphere with a lighter top dot, as spill/hop item.

voiceText: [groggy, disgusted] Who bought forty limes? [long pause] [deadpan, sarcastic] Your receipt needs a map. [long pause] [slow, serious, to camera] YOU lost yours too. Admit it. [long pause] [grudging, then warm] Scan it. Every item's in.
ytTitle: A receipt across the whole floor?! The party flat | Fridgeroo on Tour 3
voiceNote: voice a/b/at and stareAt are set from his mp3 (silencedetect) at build time
